lead: Length, payment details, limits and the last day, as a short list instead of a long paragraph.
note: The note covers exceptions: who to ask for an extension and what support a trial includes.

terms.title: Each term is a question
terms.text: It is a description list, so question and answer stay together when copied into an email.

terms.title: The answer is short
terms.text: Anything longer goes in the line below.

terms.title: The extra line is optional
terms.text: It adds a condition to the answer without breaking it up.

terms.title: The last day is stated
terms.text: It is what most readers look for.
